```{r}
#NEC ONLY 

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Within-NEC: does E. coli / K. pneumoniae status structure composition (PCoA)?
#   Model per axis:  PC ~ ecoli + kleb + (1|MM_ID)   on NEC+ samples only
#   Each bug is adjusted for the other; LRT p-values; BH-FDR across axes.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
lmer <- lme4::lmer   # unmasked by lmerTest

# ── 1. Filter to NEC+ samples (ecoli/kleb already encoded in 4D block) ─────────
nec_dat <- phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR %>%
  filter(nec == "Yes",
         !is.na(ecoli), !is.na(kleb), !is.na(MM_ID))

cat(sprintf("NEC+ samples: %d  across %d infants\n",
            nrow(nec_dat), dplyr::n_distinct(nec_dat$MM_ID)))
print(table(E.coli = nec_dat$ecoli, K.pneumoniae = nec_dat$kleb))

# Repeated-measures sanity check: a mixed model only makes sense if some infants
# contribute >1 sample. If it's one-per-infant, switch (1|MM_ID) -> plain lm().
spi <- table(nec_dat$MM_ID)
cat(sprintf("Samples per infant: median %g, range %d-%d (%d infants with >1)\n",
            median(spi), min(spi), max(spi), sum(spi > 1)))

# ── 2. Which axes to test ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pc_cols <- grep("^PC[0-9]+$", names(nec_dat), value = TRUE)
pc_cols <- pc_cols[order(as.integer(sub("PC", "", pc_cols)))]
# To match the figure (PC1/PC2 only): pc_cols <- c("PC1", "PC2")
cat("Testing axes:", paste(pc_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ── 3. Fit PC ~ ecoli + kleb + (1|MM_ID); LRT for each bug ─────────────────────
res <- lapply(pc_cols, function(pc) {
  d <- nec_dat; d$y <- d[[pc]]
  d <- d[!is.na(d$y), ]
  full  <- suppressMessages(lmer(y ~ ecoli + kleb + (1 | MM_ID), data = d, REML = FALSE))
  r_ec  <- suppressMessages(lmer(y ~          kleb + (1 | MM_ID), data = d, REML = FALSE))
  r_kl  <- suppressMessages(lmer(y ~ ecoli        + (1 | MM_ID), data = d, REML = FALSE))
  cf <- summary(full)$coefficients
  data.frame(
    PC        = pc,
    ecoli_t   = cf["ecoli", "t value"],
    ecoli_p   = anova(r_ec, full)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
    kleb_t    = cf["kleb",  "t value"],
    kleb_p    = anova(r_kl, full)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
})
res <- do.call(rbind, res)

# ── 4. BH-FDR across axes, per bug ─────────────────────────────────────────────
res$ecoli_FDR <- p.adjust(res$ecoli_p, "BH")
res$kleb_FDR  <- p.adjust(res$kleb_p,  "BH")
res <- res %>% arrange(pmin(ecoli_FDR, kleb_FDR))

cat("\n── PC ~ E. coli + K. pneumoniae status, NEC+ only ──\n")
print(res, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PERMANOVA (adonis2) — association of clinical/exposure variables
# with bacterial composition (CLR PCoA coordinates PC1–PC20)
# Corrected for DNA concentration; BH-FDR across variables
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pheno_vars <- c("prolonged_rupt", "mmpercentage", "surgery", "ab48",
                "apgar_1", "apgar_5", "multiple", "delivery_md",
                "maternal_atb", "mother_st_com", "placenta_ab", "pe_hellp",
                "maternal_infect", "mother_b_hem", "antibiotic_sample",
                "probiotic_sample", "ga_exact", "bw", "nec", "sex",
                "admissiontime", "tpn_days", "sip", "sepsis_culture",
                "pda_sign", "mortality", "week", "probiotics", "SGA",
                "LGA", "FGR", "TFEF_B", "TFEF", "ivh", "abtx",
                "alcohol", "smoking", "education_level", "cigarettes_day")

pc_vars <- paste0("PC", 1:20)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare the PCoA distance matrix
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pc_mat <- phenos_imputed_div_pc_CLR %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%                          # ensure plain data frame
  select(ID, all_of(pc_vars)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

# Set rownames explicitly rather than via column_to_rownames
rownames(pc_mat) <- pc_mat$ID
pc_mat$ID        <- NULL
pc_mat           <- as.matrix(pc_mat)

dist_ait <- dist(pc_mat, method = "euclidean")
cat(sprintf("Samples in distance matrix: %d\n", nrow(pc_mat)))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Align metadata_infant to the same sample IDs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
meta_aligned <- metadata_infant %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%                          # ensure plain data frame
  filter(ID %in% rownames(pc_mat))

rownames(meta_aligned) <- meta_aligned$ID
meta_aligned$ID        <- NULL

# Reorder to match distance matrix
meta_aligned <- meta_aligned[rownames(pc_mat), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(rownames(meta_aligned) == rownames(pc_mat)))

cat(sprintf("Samples in aligned metadata: %d\n", nrow(meta_aligned)))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Run adonis2 for each variable, correcting for DNA_conc
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)
results <- list()

for (var in pheno_vars) {

  if (!var %in% colnames(meta_aligned)) {
    cat(sprintf("Skipping %s — not found in metadata\n", var))
    next
  }

  if (!"DNA_conc" %in% colnames(meta_aligned)) {
    stop("DNA_conc not found in metadata_infant — check column name.")
  }

  # Complete cases for variable + DNA_conc
  keep <- !is.na(meta_aligned[[var]]) &
          !is.na(meta_aligned[["DNA_conc"]])

  n_complete <- sum(keep)
  if (n_complete < 10) {
    cat(sprintf("Skipping %s — only %d complete cases\n", var, n_complete))
    next
  }

  # Subset distance matrix and metadata
  dist_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(dist_ait)[keep, keep])
  meta_sub  <- meta_aligned[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  df_adonis <- data.frame(
    y       = meta_sub[[var]],
    dna_conc = as.numeric(as.character(meta_sub[["DNA_conc"]]))
  )

  fit <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      adonis2(dist_sub ~ dna_conc + y, data = df_adonis,
              permutations = 999, by = "margin")
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    cat(sprintf("adonis2 failed for %s\n", var))
    next
  }

  r2_row <- fit["y", ]

  results[[var]] <- data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    N        = n_complete,
    R2       = round(r2_row$R2,    4),
    F_stat   = round(r2_row$F,     3),
    p_value  = r2_row$`Pr(>F)`,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Compile and apply BH-FDR correction
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
results_df <- bind_rows(results) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR     = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    Sig_FDR = case_when(
      FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
      FDR < 0.01  ~ "**",
      FDR < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE        ~ ""
    )
  )

cat("\n=== PERMANOVA results (adonis2, corrected for DNA_conc, BH-FDR) ===\n")
print(results_df, row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Export to Excel
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
write_xlsx(
  list("PERMANOVA results" = results_df),
  path = "PERMANOVA_composition_associations.xlsx"
)
cat("✓ Saved: PERMANOVA_composition_associations.xlsx\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Dot plot of results
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_perm <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    Variable  = factor(Variable, levels = rev(Variable)),
    Sig_label = ifelse(FDR < 0.05,
                       sprintf("FDR=%.3f %s", FDR, Sig_FDR), "")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = R2, y = Variable, colour = FDR < 0.05)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Sig_label), hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey60", "TRUE" = "#e76f51"),
                      labels = c("ns", "FDR < 0.05"),
                      name   = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.30))) +
  labs(x        = "R² (variance explained)",
       y        = NULL,
       title    = "PERMANOVA: association with bacterial composition",
       subtitle = "adonis2, corrected for DNA concentration, BH-FDR") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_perm)
ggsave("PERMANOVA_composition_associations.pdf", p_perm,
       width = 7, height = 9)
cat("✓ Saved: PERMANOVA_composition_associations.pdf\n")
```
